summary: Iteration 4 re-verified the fix for the iteration_3 webhook_url integration bug. GET /api/settings/whatsapp now returns webhook_url built from PUBLIC_BASE_URL in /app/backend/.env, so the value shown to the owner is https://order-receipt-system-2.preview.emergentagent.com/api/whatsapp/webhook (public HTTPS host — Meta-compatible). The test suite was strengthened: TestSettingsMasking::test_verify_token_autogenerated now asserts webhook_url starts with 'https://' and equals f'{PUBLIC_BASE_URL}/api/whatsapp/webhook'. Full pytest run: 36/36 passed against the public preview URL (test_auth_register.py, test_backend_api.py, test_whatsapp_integration.py) — settings masking, PATCH auto-generation of verify_token, HMAC-signed POST /api/whatsapp/webhook (403 on bad sig, 200 on correct), GET /api/whatsapp/webhook verify (200+challenge on match, 403 on mismatch), full simulator dispatch flow (Hi→add→checkout→yes) attaching payload.whatsapp_dispatch for customer+owner in both wa-enabled-with-fake-creds and wa-disabled branches, and all pre-existing auth/menu/orders/dashboard regressions. Direct curl to /api/settings/whatsapp confirms the returned webhook_url is now the public HTTPS URL rather than the internal K8s host over http. Fix location: /app/backend/server.py lines 340–363 — os.environ['PUBLIC_BASE_URL'] preferred, then X-Forwarded-Proto/Host, then request.base_url. No regressions.
action_items: None for backend — webhook_url integration bug is fixed and verified. Pre-existing React Native deprecation warnings from iteration_3 (TouchableWithoutFeedback, shadow* style props, props.pointerEvents) are still worth cleaning up but were not part of this iteration's scope.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix in /app/backend/server.py get_whatsapp_settings (lines 340-363) uses correct priority: PUBLIC_BASE_URL env → X-Forwarded-Proto/Host → request.base_url. This is robust: env wins under K8s ingress, forwarded headers work behind other reverse proxies, and local dev still works with request.base_url.
PUBLIC_BASE_URL is stored in /app/backend/.env (a protected env var pattern — good), not hardcoded in server.py.
No other server.py changes were introduced, so the previously validated masking / verify-token / HMAC / simulator dispatch behaviour remains intact.

If PUBLIC_BASE_URL is ever removed from /app/backend/.env, the endpoint gracefully falls back to X-Forwarded-Proto/Host then request.base_url. rca_of_issue: Original iter_3 bug: FastAPI request.base_url reflects the internal K8s service host (over http) because the ingress performs TLS termination and rewrites Host. Applied fix: GET /api/settings/whatsapp first checks os.environ['PUBLIC_BASE_URL'] (now set to https://order-receipt-system-2.preview.emergentagent.com in /app/backend/.env), then honors X-Forwarded-Proto/Host, then falls back to request.base_url. Verified via pytest + direct curl against the public URL.
